headline: Adds Profession Shopping List purchases at vendors and a Guild Wars 2 theme for Next, alongside instance vendor fixes.

entries.title: Profession Shopping List buying at vendors
entries.details: When visiting a merchant that sells items from your Profession Shopping List, a dedicated card appears in the vendor window. You can purchase all needed reagents at once with a double-click, or right-click the card to dismiss it.

entries.title: Guild Wars 2 theme for Next
entries.details: When the GW2_UI addon is active, BetterBags Next now includes a Guild Wars 2 theme with authentic window frames, side-rail buttons, emblems, and matching controls.

entries.title: Error opening vendors in dungeons and raids
entries.details: Fixed a Lua error caused by restricted NPC names when speaking to a vendor inside an instance.

entries.title: Bank error with Parchment and Quiet themes
entries.details: Fixed an error in Next when opening the bank or guild bank while using themes that do not use a background color wash.
